Hidden Gem - elegant ambiance in dining
Aug 2024 • Couples
We came by by accident exploring the alleyways near our hotel wandering home from dinner and WOW what a hidden gem. We ended up going in for a cocktail then discovered it was happy hour with two for one cocktails so decided it would be fiscally irresponsible not to try a few of their signature cocktail and we where suitably impressed. 
We decided to return the following night for dinner opting for the set menu. The scollop entree - perfect, the second being soft shell crab. Our mains, the beef cheek was a little over powering (salty) with the sauce otherwise perfect, the salmon was nice but served not with the salad as on the menu which was a little disappointing, the desert was lovely. 
Overall the service, cocktail list and the ambiance where spot on and given our bill for drinks and a set menu for two came to $160 (AUD) which compared to anywhere else in the world would be x4 the price i consider the 'OX' to be priced well.
This is one i highly recommend at this price point .

Unimaginative food. Owner has lost interest in the project.
Apr 2023 • Couples
Not for us. Booked after doing a Google search for top Vietnamese food Saigon. Should have looked on Trip Advisor as I normally do. Only 2 other tables in use when we arrived on a Thursday at 9.00pm. They were soon empty so we were the only diners in the large dining space. Main thing on the staffs mind was going home. No more orders after 9.30pm. The food was hot and tasty but, for the most part, unimaginative. Certainly I could cook the chicken thighs with a sweet soy sauce. In at 9.00pm out at 10pm, 2,500,000 dong poorer. Not the event meal I'd hoped for.

Attention to detail, sort of ..
Jun 2022 • Friends
I visited in a group of 4 on Saturday 25/6 at 7pm. The meet and greet was pleasant and we were seated within a few minutes. Our waitress was a pleasant young lady whose English was more than acceptable and welcome. Entrees were good, mains were ok as were the accompanying sides. The musical duo added to the general ambience too. This establishment loses points for minor things that obviously add up. Additional coffees were ordered but not received. A glass of wine was also ordered but not received, even though a second staff member came and advised one of my guests that the wine he had selected was unavailable and a second option was agreed to, but, not received. And what grated more than the above was that if we are paying over 150vnd for a bottle of water, Italian I believe, at least have the awareness to open the bottles at the table. Common sense I’d have assumed. They did however remove the tiramisu that was definitely nqr. Overall, the restaurant is ok, but it feels as though most of the attention is focused solely on the food and not the whole experience.

OK but you won't feel happy to come again
Nov 2020 • Couples
We went there on a Saturday night.
The ground floor was booked for a birthday party.
We ordered the Squid salad, a seasonal mushroom soup, slow cooked beef rib and grilled lamb rack.
The Squid salad is nothing special, I will give it a mark of 50. But for the mushroom soup, sorry to say it just likes putting the mushroom in the water and serve, no taste and nothing.
But the slow cooked beef rib was good, 85 marks may be, and the lamb rack was marvelous, texture and taste are excellent, highly recommended.
For service, I would say is amateurish. the young male waiter just ok but did not know how to introduce the menu. We got two main dishes and he just gave us one knife, might be he would like to see us eating the lamb rack with our hands.
When the mushroom served was served, it was a little bit full and the female waitress just put it on the table carelessly and some soup fell out from the bowl onto the table. All she did is saying that it is full to herself and just gone away without cleaning it and saying sorry.
Overall, main dishes are good but you won’t feel happy to have the meal there with only 50% of the food is ok with a poor service……May come again for the lamb but definitely not a place you will feel excited about to visit frequently.

A great find
Sep 2020
This now has to be our first choice in Ho Chi Minh! 
We were looking for somewhere to have Sunday Lunch and my daughter said we should try here as it had been recommended by some of her friends. And we weren’t let down! We loved everything - the service was great, lovely settings (hidden away down an alleyway) and of course the food. 

We had a mixture of dishes for starters and everything was amazing. The prawn salad was my favourite, whilst the little one loved the salmon so much she asked for two! The main course was excellent also. My son had the Wagu beef that was so tender and served with a lovely sauce, whereas my eldest daughter had the pork ribs. She said they were the most tender ribs she’s ever had and ended up using her fingers to make sure only the bones were left!!

A real gem and we all hope to be back soon!
